summary.text: Virgil Weigel is a Democratic state representative from Kansas House District 56 who has represented the district since January 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Weigel previously held the same seat from 2012 to 2015 and served in the U.S. Army.

paragraphs.text: Virgil Weigel was born in Hays, Kansas, and graduated from high school in 1971.
He served in the U.S. Army from 1971 to 1974 as an armored crewman, then earned a bachelor of arts from Fort Hays State University in 1982 and a master's degree in political science in 1983.

His career experience includes work with the Hays Police Department, the U.S. Border Patrol, the MTAA Police Department and the Kansas Department of Revenue/ABC, and he has been a member of the Boy Scouts, the Safe Streets Advisory Board, American Legion Post 400 and the Neighborhood Watch.
Weigel first served in the Kansas House of Representatives for District 56 from 2012 to 2015, and he returned to the seat on January 9, 2017.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Financial Institutions and Pensions, House Transportation, Transportation and Public Safety Budget, and Veterans and Military committees.
He defeated Braeden Curwick in the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Elvin Fajardo in the general election.
